review.method: Every message and gold span read on CPU in source order; full offset/substring and overlap checks. No new messages; benchmark and gate data not opened for audit. drop=true removes the row in THIS patch (unfilled authoring placeholders); old Opus patch retains its registered label-replacement meaning.
review.coverage_limits: Manual semantic review is fallible; no assertion of semantic disjointness from inaccessible sealed corpora. Phrasing gaps are reported, never filled from held-out/gate content.
